mathematics.assertion_tested: Recovery products, obstruction witnesses, kernel bases, exact row-operation matrices, invariant summaries, and minimum sufficient repairs agree with independent Fraction/minor calculations in every generated case.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Rational matrix entries, exact Fraction and BigInt arithmetic; interpreted as real-linear maps.
mathematics.conventions: Column input vectors; only enabled measurement rows contribute to R; ranks from all square minors in the independent oracle.
inputs: 250 seeded rational cases with 2..4 coordinates, 1..4 measurement rows, 1..3 question rows, including disabled rows and supported numerator/denominator bounds
non_claims: Not exhaustive over all supported rational inputs.
No manuscript proof review or Lean execution.
Does not test noisy or approximate recovery.
